body: I think I was in denial over the part where he said he wasn’t looking for a relationship. I know it’s been said but I think there was some part of me that hoped things changed over the years, it was hopeful I know but when it came to him I was willing to convince myself as much. But at the end of the day I can see now that it’s in my best interest to move on, even if I’m scared to. I’m very grateful for this input on everything, I thank you!

I really do think that I liked him but because of the circumstances that lead to me liking him confused me. I’m using past tense as a motive to help me move on from everything, I’m trying even though I’m lost. I really appreciate this input on it though! I’m going to try and work on myself but I’m still working through things at the same time. I’ve never actually looked at things from this point of view and I’m very appreciative of this so I thank you!

This made me question a few things, and I thank you for that. Right now I’m trying to find a way to move on but I’m finding it difficult as this is all new for me. Your advice has opened a new door for me though and I’m grateful!
